A_0_0_chasing_120.interpretation: Calm, low pressure platform; minimal situational leverage

B_0_0_chasing_160.interpretation: Standard opening chase platform; moderate context dampening

C_0_0_chasing_190.interpretation: High target pressure elevates P1 to near-par (45-50); L ≈ 1.0

D_0_2_chasing_190.interpretation: High target compounded by early wickets lost; leverage rises to 1.15-1.20

E_20_3_chasing_190.interpretation: Acute crisis in steep chase; leverage scales to 1.25-1.30+

context_differentiation.finding: A 20/3 or 50/5 collapse late in a chase receives substantially higher P1 (82.4 vs 53.4) than early in the first innings, because overs remaining, required RR, and wicket scarcity combine multiplicatively.

simulation_cases.name: Normal Elite Opener
simulation_cases.description: 0/0, 1st innings, opening batter, no collapse difficulty (80 off 48)
simulation_cases.expected_behavior: Excellent score; mild context dampening; no unfair 0/0 penalty

simulation_cases.name: Elite Chase Opener
simulation_cases.description: 0/0, 2nd innings, chasing steep target 190 (RRR ≈ 9.5+, 80 off 45)
simulation_cases.expected_behavior: High P1 relative to 1st inn opener; chase pressure represented; L ≈ 1.0

simulation_cases.name: Collapse Rescue
simulation_cases.description: Enters at 20/3, scores match-winning 80 off 50
simulation_cases.expected_behavior: High P1, high P2, high P3; strong leverage amplification; very high score

simulation_cases.name: Collapse Failure
simulation_cases.description: Enters at 20/3, fails under crisis (scores 5 off 15, dismissed)
simulation_cases.expected_behavior: High P1 multiplies negative deviation; heavy penalty; zero pressure bonus

simulation_cases.name: Dual-Role Batter
simulation_cases.description: Enters at 20/3, scores 80 off 50, stabilizes, anchors 15 ov, accelerates late
simulation_cases.expected_behavior: Naturally recognized through P2/P3; peak reward without player-type bonus

simulation_cases.name: Collapse Rescue with Moderate Batting
simulation_cases.description: Enters at 20/3, battles sluggishly for 35 off 40
simulation_cases.expected_behavior: High P1 alone does NOT create an elite score; remains around par (47-49)

representative_14_archetypes.commentary: Massive 1st innings opening knock (77 off 38); relieved of 0/0 context tax
Early duck in 1st innings; low P1 does not protect poor batting
Chasing 184 at 9.2 RRR; P1 reflects chase pressure; dominant match-winner
Early dismissal in chase; properly penalized without artificial protection
Enters at 12/2 chasing 209; sensational 96 off 57 under heavy chase pressure
Enters at 119/5 needing 60 off 22 balls; explosive death counter-attack rescue
Enters at 7/4 in PP; anchors 15 overs, stabilizes, accelerates late -> dual-role mastery
Fails immediately in collapse; high leverage removes 23 free participation points
Neutral context entry (P1=50.0); L=1.000 exact; proposed score matches 50/50 mean
Brilliant individual striking (P2=82.9) but chase collapses (P3=25.4) -> balanced 53.6
Tailender supporting end under extreme death context
104* in 198 total, but team loses; loss does not penalize masterclass -> 92.7
Sluggish batting in won match; winning team adds 0 artificial points -> 23.4
Investigates P3-ISSUE-01: RRR blowout to 29.0 severely depresses P3 (8.5) -> 22.1
